priorRoles: Executive Vice President and co-founder, Consumer Energy Alliance (2008-2019)
biography.background: Born in WNC (Western North Carolina). Spent 2008-2019 as EVP and co-founder of Consumer Energy Alliance, a fossil fuel industry advocacy group funded by BP, Chevron, ExxonMobil, Marathon, Shell, and Statoil. Chaired NC GOP from 2019-2024, then served as RNC Chair 2024-2025. Endorsed by President Donald Trump before officially entering the race. Holds ~38% support in Feb 2026 GOP primary polling with ~50% undecided. Raised $6.27 million as of Feb 11, 2026; $2.5M+ cash on hand. NRSC-backed. Clear front-runner for the Republican nomination.

statedPositions.notes: 2026 campaign uses 'all-of-the-above including carbon' framing with no climate action commitments. Career background: 2008-2019 at Consumer Energy Alliance opposing low-carbon fuel standards, fracking regulations, power plant emission rules, and advocating for offshore Atlantic drilling.
